g1.label: 1. New Zealand ___ as Aotearoa
g1.why: Present simple passive: “is” + the past participle “known”.

g2.label: 2. The Treaty of Waitangi ___ in 1840
g2.why: A completed past event with a singular subject takes “was” + past participle.

g3.label: 3. Many native birds ___ by predators
g3.why: “Birds” is plural, so the present passive is “are threatened”.

g4.label: 4. The haka ___ by the All Blacks
g4.why: “The haka” is singular, so the present passive is “is performed”.

g5.label: 5. The kiwi bird ___ by programmes
g5.why: The bird receives the action, so it is “is protected”, not “is protecting”.

g6.label: 6. The two main islands ___ by the Cook Strait
g6.why: A plural subject takes “are” + past participle.

g7.label: 7. Rotorua ___ on a geothermal field
g7.why: A completed past action with a singular subject: “was built”.

g8.label: 8. The Māori language ___ in many schools
g8.why: Present passive with a singular subject: “is taught”.
